summary: A signed-in account creates a short-lived pairing code; axod redeems it with a generated credential and current host generation, creating or rotating the account's linked host credential.
trigger: User initiates host pairing from app settings and daemon redeems the presented one-time code.

steps.action: Authenticate account with CSRF protection, apply issuance rate limits, create a random code and store only a purpose-separated HMAC verifier; reserve verifier in the pairing index.

Generate 32 random bytes and store them in Keychain before network use; persist pending credential ID and current host generation in a strict mode-0600 config, then redeem the normalized code over TLS with host identity and credential material. A transport failure retries the redemption once.
Bound and parse request body, apply global/source redemption rate limits, look up unexpired verifier, HMAC the credential and atomically consume pairing into account host storage.
Return linked host identity and credential ID; if an existing host credential was rotated, close the previous host relay.
